questions.question: Ssenariy: muhandis staging'ga tasodifan `terraform destroy` ishga tushirib, o'rtasida to'xtatdi. Qanday tiklaysiz?
questions.explanation: Qolib ketgan lock'ni bo'shatish: terraform force-unlock <LOCK-ID>.

questions.question: Ssenariy: 500 resursli monolit state'ni 5 ta mustaqil state'ga zero-downtime qanday bo'lasiz?
questions.explanation: Prod state'ning backup'i.

questions.question: Ssenariy: 50TB ma'lumotli prod S3 bucket qo'lda yaratilgan. Uni ma'lumot yo'qotish xavfisiz Terraform boshqaruviga qanday olasiz?
questions.explanation: HCL'da e'lon: resource "aws_s3_bucket" "prod_data" { bucket = "company-prod-data" }.

questions.question: Enterprise miqyosda Crossplane va Terraform solishtiring.
questions.explanation: Terraform: pipeline'da batch bajariladi; drift faqat pipeline ishlaganda ko'rinadi; ekotizim katta.

questions.question: Prod uchun ko'p muhitli Terragrunt repo'sini qanday tuzasiz?
questions.explanation: root/

questions.question: Terraform'da credential'larni diskka yozmasdan zero-trust secret injection qanday qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Vault dynamic secrets (data "vault_aws_access_credentials") yoki CI OIDC: Terraform talab bo'yicha qisqa muddatli (masalan 1 soatlik) credential oladi — statik kalitlar umuman yo'q.

questions.question: Ssenariy: DB parollari bor prod `.tfstate` GitHub'ga commit qilindi. To'liq javob tartibi qanday?
questions.explanation: Barcha secret'larni darhol rotatsiya: DB master parol, TLS private key, IAM credential'lar — bu birinchi qadam, chunki tarix tozalansa ham nusxa olingan bo'lishi mumkin.

questions.question: AWS EC2 uchun Ansible dynamic inventory nima?
questions.explanation: aws_ec2 plugin AWS API'ni so'rab instance'larni tag bo'yicha avtomatik guruhlaydi (tag_Role_webservers) — statik IP fayllari kerak emas.

questions.question: Pulumi stack nima?
questions.explanation: Pulumi dasturining alohida, mustaqil sozlanadigan nusxasi (dev, staging, prod) — o'z state'i va secret shifrlash provayderi bilan.

questions.question: Pulumi Crosswalk nima?
questions.explanation: Well-architected best practice'larni amalga oshiruvchi yuqori darajali kutubxonalar (masalan prod VPC'ni 5 qatorda yaratish).

questions.question: Crossplane provider family nima?
questions.explanation: Modulli provider paketlari (provider-aws-s3, provider-aws-rds) — faqat kerakli CRD controller'lar o'rnatiladi, klasterda CRD soni portlab ketmaydi.

questions.question: Crossplane Composition Function nima?
questions.explanation: Statik YAML ifodalay olmaydigan murakkab kompozitsiya va shartlarni dinamik render qiladigan gRPC funksiyalar (Go, Python, KCL).

questions.question: Unit testda Terraform provider'ni mock qilish nima?
questions.explanation: Haqiqiy cloud chaqiruvlarisiz HCL mantiqini tekshirish uchun provider javoblarini mock qilish (terraform test + mock_provider).

questions.question: Terraform `replace_triggered_by` nima?
questions.explanation: Boshqa resurs yoki atribut o'zgarganda resursni majburan qayta yaratuvchi lifecycle atributi.

questions.question: OpenTofu state encryption kalitini qanday rotatsiya qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Konfiguratsiyada yangi kalitni e'lon qilib, eskisini fallback sifatida qoldirib tofu apply — state shaffof qayta shifrlanadi.

questions.question: Ansible `async` va `poll` nima?
questions.explanation: Uzoq task'larni (DB backup) fonda asinxron bajarib, holatini vaqti-vaqti bilan tekshirish (poll: 0 — kutmasdan davom etish).

questions.question: Ansible handler nima?
questions.explanation: Boshqa task changed bo'lib notify qilgandagina bajariladigan maxsus task (masalan nginx.conf o'zgarganda nginx reload); play oxirida bir marta ishlaydi.

questions.question: Ansible `serial` nima?
questions.explanation: Playbook'ni serverlar batch'lari bo'yicha bajarish (serial: "20%") — zero-downtime rolling update (max_fail_percentage bilan).

questions.question: Ansible Tower / AWX nima?
questions.explanation: Ansible playbook, inventory, credential va RBAC'ni markaziy boshqarish uchun web UI, REST API va task engine.

questions.question: Terraform `nonsensitive()` nima?
questions.explanation: Sezgir qiymatni zarurat bo'lganda sezgir emas deb belgilaydi — ehtiyot bilan ishlating (secret log'ga chiqishi mumkin).

questions.question: Output'da `depends_on` nima?
questions.explanation: Output baholanishini belgilangan resurslar tugagandan keyinga aniq qo'yish.

questions.question: Terraform modul nesting bo'yicha best practice qanday?
questions.explanation: Ko'pi bilan 2 daraja (root → child modul). Ortiqcha nesting mo'rt dependency grafi va qo'llab-quvvatlab bo'lmaydigan kodga olib keladi.

questions.question: `.terraformrc` (CLI konfiguratsiyasi) nima?
questions.explanation: Workstation yoki CI'da plugin cache, credential helper va provider installation mirror'larini boshqaruvchi fayl.

questions.question: `TF_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR` nima?
questions.explanation: Provider binary'larini diskda cache'lab ko'p papkalarda qayta ishlatish — bandwidth va CI vaqti tejaladi.

questions.question: Policy as Code shift-left testing nima?
questions.explanation: OPA/Checkov'ni pre-commit va PR build'larda ishlatib, compliance buzilishlarini main ga merge'dan oldin ushlash.

questions.question: Terraform JSON sintaksisi (`*.tf.json`) nima?
questions.explanation: Konfiguratsiyani HCL o'rniga standart JSON'da yozish — mashina generatsiya qiladigan shablonlar uchun.

questions.question: Pulumi Automation API nima?
questions.explanation: Infra provisioning'ni ilova kodi ichiga joylaydigan SDK (masalan SaaS ilova Go'dan tenant DB'larini dasturiy yaratadi).

questions.question: Crossplane EnvironmentConfig nima?
questions.explanation: Umumiy global konfiguratsiya (akkaunt ID, muhit nomi) ni Composition'larga dinamik uzatish.

questions.question: Ansible fact gathering (`setup` moduli) nima?
questions.explanation: Playbook boshida target host'lardan hardware, OS, tarmoq va disk ma'lumotlarini yig'ib ansible_facts ga yozish (gather_facts: false bilan tezlashtirish mumkin).

questions.question: Terraform `required_version` cheklovi nima?
questions.explanation: Konfiguratsiyani mos engine versiyalariga qotirish (required_version = ">= 1.5.0, < 2.0.0") — sintaksis mos kelmasligining oldini olish.

questions.question: Terraform provider source address nima?
questions.explanation: Provider'ning to'liq global nomi: registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws.

questions.question: OpenTofu Registry nima?
questions.explanation: OpenTofu uchun provider va modullarni joylaydigan ochiq, hamjamiyat boshqaradigan public registry.

questions.question: Terragrunt `run-all` nima?
questions.explanation: Barcha subpapkalarda Terraform buyruqlarini dependency (DAG) tartibida rekursiv bajaradi (terragrunt run-all plan; yangi versiyalarda run --all).

questions.question: DynamoDB'da Terraform state locking qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Lock ID va state MD5 digest'i strongly consistent DynamoDB jadvaliga yoziladi — parallel apply bloklanadi. (Terraform 1.10+ da S3'ning o'zida use_lockfile bilan lock mumkin.)

questions.question: Infracost FinOps shift-left nima?
questions.explanation: PR'larga avtomatik xarajat farqi izohlarini yozish — dasturchi merge'dan oldin moliyaviy ta'sirni ko'radi.

questions.question: Trivy IaC scanning nima?
questions.explanation: Terraform, CloudFormation va Dockerfile'ni minglab ichki misconfiguration tekshiruvlari bo'yicha skanerlash.

questions.question: Checkov custom policy nima?
questions.explanation: Tashkilotga xos compliance qoidalarini (Python yoki YAML/Rego) yozib, CI'da Terraform'ga nisbatan baholash.

questions.question: Ansible Galaxy nima?
questions.explanation: Ansible role va collection'larni topish, yuklash va ulashish uchun public hamjamiyat repo'si.

questions.question: Pulumi secrets provider nima?
questions.explanation: State'dagi sezgir qiymatlarni cloud KMS (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, Vault) bilan shifrlash.

questions.question: Crossplane package manager nima?
questions.explanation: Provider va Configuration'larni OCI artifact sifatida standart registry'da versiyalab tarqatish va o'rnatish.

questions.question: `terraform state show` nima?
questions.explanation: Bitta resursning state'dagi aniq atributlarini chiqaradi.

questions.question: `terraform state list` nima?
questions.explanation: State'dagi barcha resurs manzillarini ro'yxatlaydi.

questions.question: Plan output fayli (`-out=tfplan`) nima?
questions.explanation: Hisoblangan plan'ni diskka saqlaydi — terraform apply tfplan aynan shu diff'ni bajaradi (CI'da plan → review → apply uchun muhim). Plan faylida secret bo'lishi mumkin.

questions.question: Terraform variable `validation` bloki nima?
questions.explanation: Input variable'larga bajarishdan oldin custom qoidalar:

questions.question: Sezgir variable'dan olingan output qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Sezgir qiymatdan hosil bo'lgan output'ni ham sensitive = true deb belgilash talab qilinadi (aks holda Terraform xato beradi) va u CLI'da yashiriladi.

questions.question: Terraform dynamic provider credentials nima?
questions.explanation: CI (GitHub Actions) OIDC token'ini apply paytida vaqtinchalik cloud credential'ga almashtirish — statik kalit yo'q.

questions.question: `terraform state pull` nima?
questions.explanation: Remote backend'dagi xom JSON state'ni stdout'ga yuklab chiqaradi.

questions.question: `terraform state push` nima?
questions.explanation: O'zgartirilgan state'ni remote backend'ga qo'lda yuklaydi — state DR uchun; xavfli, serial/lineage tekshiruvlariga e'tibor.

questions.question: Terraform Enterprise private module registry nima?
questions.explanation: Versiyalash, hujjat generatsiyasi va kirish nazoratiga ega ichki modul registry.

questions.question: Terragrunt scaffold nima?
questions.explanation: Terraform moduldan Terragrunt konfiguratsiya shablonini avtomatik generatsiya qiladigan buyruq.

questions.question: Terraform'dan OpenTofu'ga state migratsiyasi qanday?
questions.explanation: OpenTofu mavjud Terraform state'larini (Terraform 1.5/1.6 gacha versiyalardan) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'qiydi va yozadi — odatda faqat binary almashtiriladi; yangi Terraform-only funksiyalarni tekshiring.

questions.question: Ansible Jinja2 templating nima?
questions.explanation: template moduli bilan Jinja2 sintaksisida o'zgaruvchi va loop'lar orqali config fayllarni dinamik yaratish.

questions.question: Ansible `block` va `rescue` nima?
questions.explanation: Playbook'da exception handling: block task'lari bajariladi, biri yiqilsa rescue task'lari tuzatish uchun ishlaydi; always har doim.

questions.question: Ansible check mode (`--check`) nima?
questions.explanation: Serverlarni o'zgartirmasdan qanday o'zgarishlar bo'lishini ko'rsatadigan dry-run (--diff bilan farqlar).

questions.question: Pulumi CrossGuard nima?
questions.explanation: TypeScript yoki Python'da yozilgan compliance qoidalarini resurslar yaratilishidan oldin Pulumi stack'larida majburlovchi Policy as Code.

questions.question: Crossplane uchun Upjet nima?
questions.explanation: Terraform provider sxemalaridan Crossplane provider'larini avtomatik generatsiya qiladi — cloud resurslarini keng qamrab olish.

questions.question: Terraform Cloud Agent nima?
questions.explanation: Private VPC'da ishlaydigan self-hosted worker — Terraform Cloud run'larini ichki private resurslarga nisbatan bajaradi.

questions.question: `terraform.tfvars` nima?
questions.explanation: E'lon qilingan variable'lar uchun qiymatlarni o'z ichiga olgan, avtomatik yuklanadigan fayl.

questions.question: Terraform workspace izolyatsiyasi qachon anti-pattern?
questions.explanation: Staging va prod turli AWS akkaunt, IAM role yoki backend talab qilganda workspace ishlatish — bitta backend va credential bo'lishiladi, xato muhitga apply xavfi.

questions.question: `-lock-timeout` nima?
questions.explanation: Lock olish uchun belgilangan vaqtgacha (-lock-timeout=5m) kutish, keyin yiqilish.

questions.question: Child modul output'iga qanday murojaat qilinadi?
questions.explanation: module.<name>.<output_name> orqali parent modulda.

questions.question: Terraform implicit dependency nima?
questions.explanation: Bir resurs boshqasining atributiga murojaat qilganda (vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id) avtomatik paydo bo'ladigan bog'liqlik.

questions.question: Terraform explicit dependency (`depends_on`) nima?
questions.explanation: Kodda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri atribut murojaati bo'lmaganda bog'liqlik tartibini qo'lda e'lon qilish (masalan IAM policy tarqalishini kutish). Ortiqcha ishlatmang — plan'ni noaniq qiladi.

questions.question: Child modulga provider alias qanday uzatiladi?
questions.explanation: Modul chaqiruvida providers = { aws = aws.west } map'i orqali.

questions.question: OpenTofu early backend evaluation nima?
questions.explanation: Backend bloki ichida variable va funksiyalarni nativ baholash — OpenTofu'ga xos imkoniyat.

questions.question: Ansible `delegate_to` nima?
questions.explanation: Muayyan task'ni boshqa host'da bajarish (masalan instance'ni load balancer'dan chiqarishni control node yoki LB'da).

questions.question: Ansible `local_action` nima?
questions.explanation: Task'ni Ansible control mashinasida lokal bajarish uchun qisqa sintaksis (delegate_to: localhost bilan bir xil).

questions.question: Pulumi resource transformation nima?
questions.explanation: Stack'dagi barcha resurslar argumentlarini dasturiy ushlab o'zgartirish (masalan hammasiga avtomatik tag qo'shish).

questions.question: Crossplane connection secret nima?
questions.explanation: Cloud provayder yaratgan DB parol va endpoint URL'larini ilova ishlatishi uchun to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Kubernetes Secret'ga yozish.

questions.question: S3 backend key nomlash konvensiyasi qanday?
questions.explanation: State fayllarni strukturali yo'llarda saqlash: <env>/<layer>/terraform.tfstate (masalan prod/network/terraform.tfstate) — har qatlam va muhit alohida.

questions.question: `terraform init -reconfigure` nima?
questions.explanation: Backend sozlamalarini .terraform/ dagi eski cache'ni e'tiborsiz qoldirib noldan sozlaydi (state ko'chirilmaydi).

questions.question: `terraform init -migrate-state` nima?
questions.explanation: State'ni bir backend turidan boshqasiga avtomatik ko'chiradi (masalan local'dan S3'ga).

questions.question: Provider-defined function nima?
questions.explanation: Zamonaviy provider'lar e'lon qiladigan, maxsus string/kripto transformatsiyalarni bajaradigan HCL funksiyalari (provider::aws::arn_parse(...)).

questions.question: Terragrunt hook'lari nima?
questions.explanation: Terraform bajarilishidan oldin yoki keyin custom skript/buyruq bajarish (before_hook, after_hook).

questions.question: OpenTofu registry mirroring nima?
questions.explanation: Air-gapped muhitda provider va modul yuklashni private korporativ mirror'larga yo'naltirish.

questions.question: Ansible meta dependencies (`meta/main.yml`) nima?
questions.explanation: Parent role'dan oldin avtomatik bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan prerequisite role'larni e'lon qilish.

questions.question: Ansible custom filter plugin nima?
questions.explanation: Playbook ichidagi Jinja2 transformatsiyalarini kengaytirish uchun custom Python funksiyalari.

questions.question: Pulumi ComponentResource nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta primitiv resursni bitta qayta ishlatiladigan komponentga jamlaydigan yuqori darajali mantiqiy resurs.

questions.question: Crossplane ProviderConfig nima?
questions.explanation: Cloud provider uchun autentifikatsiya credential'lari va assume-role konfiguratsiyasini belgilovchi CRD.

questions.question: Terraform `flatten()` nima?
questions.explanation: Ichma-ich list'larni bitta tekis list'ga aylantiradi — ichki for_each kolleksiyalarida tez-tez ishlatiladi.

questions.question: Terraform `element()` nima?
questions.explanation: List'dan indeks bo'yicha element oladi; indeks uzunlikdan oshsa modul bo'yicha aylanadi.

questions.question: Terraform `setproduct()` nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta set/list'ning Dekart ko'paytmasi — masalan muhit × subnet kombinatsiyalari.

questions.question: Terraform `zipmap()` nima?
questions.explanation: Key'lar list'i va mos qiymatlar list'idan map yasaydi.

questions.question: Terraform `one()` nima?
questions.explanation: yoki 1 elementli list'ni skalyar yoki null ga aylantiradi; ko'p element bo'lsa xato beradi.

questions.question: OpenTofu state encryption'da key derivation nima?
questions.explanation: Passphrase'dan shifrlash kalitini PBKDF2 (SHA-512/256) bilan hosil qilish.

questions.question: Terragrunt auto-init nima?
questions.explanation: Backend yoki provider sozlamalari o'zgarganda Terragrunt avtomatik terraform init bajaradi.

questions.question: Ansible `lookup()` nima?
questions.explanation: Playbook bajarilishida tashqi manbalardan (env, Vault, AWS SSM, fayl) dinamik ma'lumot olish (control node'da bajariladi).

questions.question: Ansible `lineinfile` moduli nima?
questions.explanation: Faylda regex bo'yicha ma'lum qator mavjudligini yoki o'zgartirilishini ta'minlaydi (ko'p qatorli o'zgarish uchun blockinfile/template afzal).

questions.question: Pulumi StackReference nima?
questions.explanation: Boshqa stack'ning eksport qilingan output'larini o'qish (new StackReference("org/proj/prod")).

questions.question: Crossplane management policies nima?
questions.explanation: Crossplane cloud resurs ustida qaysi amallarni bajara olishini nozik boshqarish (Observe, Create, Update, Delete) — masalan faqat kuzatish (import).

questions.question: Terraform modul uchun Git source sintaksisi qanday?
questions.explanation: Tag bilan: source = "git::https://github.com/org/repo.git?ref=v1.2.0".

questions.question: Git repo subpapkasidagi modulga qanday murojaat qilinadi?
questions.explanation: source = "git::https://github.com/org/repo.git//modules/vpc?ref=v1.2.0" — // subpapkani ajratadi.

questions.question: Provider'larni majburan qayta yuklash qanday qilinadi?
questions.explanation: terraform/providers papkasini o'chirib terraform init (yoki init -upgrade).

questions.question: Terraform Cloud workspace VCS integratsiyasi nima?
questions.explanation: GitHub/GitLab'dagi aniq branch'ga commit bo'lganda avtomatik plan va apply (PR'larda speculative plan).

questions.question: `tofu test` / `terraform test` nima?
questions.explanation: HCL assertion bloklarini vaqtinchalik infra yoki mock'larga nisbatan baholaydigan nativ test framework (.tftest.hcl).

questions.question: Terragrunt `include` bloki nima?
questions.explanation: Parent terragrunt.hcl dan konfiguratsiyani child muhit papkalariga meros qilish.

questions.question: Ansible `become: true` nima?
questions.explanation: Target node'da task'larni sudo yoki root huquqi bilan bajarish (privilege escalation).

questions.question: Ansible tag'lari (`--tags`) nima?
questions.explanation: Playbook'dagi ma'lum tag bilan belgilangan task'lar qismini bajarish (--skip-tags teskarisi).

questions.question: Pulumi dynamic provider nima?
questions.explanation: Maxsus REST API'lar uchun CRUD metodlarini TypeScript/Python'da yozib custom provider yaratish.

questions.question: Crossplane composition patching nima?
questions.explanation: Abstrakt Claim maydonlarini (masalan storage hajmi) ostidagi aniq cloud resurs spec'iga (EBS volume) map qilish.

questions.question: `terraform apply -refresh-only` nima?
questions.explanation: Jonli cloud atributlarini state'ga yozadi, hech qanday resursni o'zgartirmaydi (drift'ni qabul qilish).

questions.question: Terraform `-target` nima va nega anti-pattern?
questions.explanation: Plan/apply'ni bitta resurs bilan cheklaydi. Xavf: dependency grafini chetlab o'tadi — yetim resurslar va drift; faqat favqulodda holatda.

questions.question: `-parallelism=N` nima?
questions.explanation: Terraform bir vaqtda nechta resurs operatsiyasini bajarishini boshqaradi (default 10) — API rate limit'da kamaytiriladi.

questions.question: Provider checksum mos kelmasligi xatosi nimani bildiradi?
questions.explanation: Yuklangan provider checksum'i .terraform.lock.hcl ga mos emas — fayl buzilgan, boshqa platforma hash'i yo'q (providers lock -platform=...) yoki o'zgartirilgan (tampering).

questions.question: Terragrunt `generate` bloki nima?
questions.explanation: Bajarishdan oldin ishchi papkada boilerplate .tf fayllarini (provider, backend) dinamik generatsiya qiladi.

questions.question: Ansible `stat` moduli nima?
questions.explanation: Remote host'dagi fayl holati va metadata'sini (mavjudligi, ruxsatlar, checksum) oladi.

questions.question: Ansible `template` va `copy` farqi.
questions.explanation: copy statik faylni bayt-ma-bayt nusxalaydi; template Jinja2 bilan o'zgaruvchi va loop'larni render qilib keyin nusxalaydi.

questions.question: Pulumi bilan dynamic secrets nima?
questions.explanation: Provisioning paytida Vault'dan qisqa muddatli credential'larni dinamik olish.

questions.question: Crossplane reconcile rate limit nima?
questions.explanation: Cloud API rate limit'larga urilmaslik uchun controller reconcile intervali va tezligini sozlash (--poll-interval, --max-reconcile-rate).

questions.question: Terraform state lock ID nima?
questions.explanation: Operatsiya boshlanganda yaratiladigan noyob UUID — lock store'da qaysi process lock ushlab turganini aniqlaydi.

questions.question: `-compact-warnings` nima?
questions.explanation: CLI'dagi ogohlantirishlarni qisqa ko'rinishda chiqaradi.

questions.question: `TF_LOG=DEBUG` nima?
questions.explanation: Ichki debug log'larini, jumladan cloud API HTTP request/response'larini chiqaradi (TF_LOG_PATH bilan faylga) — log'da secret bo'lishi mumkin.

questions.question: Terraform'dan OpenTofu'ga o'tish qanday?
questions.explanation: OpenTofu Terraform konfiguratsiya va state'lari uchun drop-in CLI almashtiruvchi; o'tishdan oldin backup va tofu plan da nol o'zgarishni tekshiring.

questions.question: Terragrunt'da konfiguratsiyani Terraform'siz tekshirish qanday?
questions.explanation: terragrunt render-json / validate-inputs kabi buyruqlar bilan meros va input'larni Terraform bajarmasdan tekshirish.

questions.question: `ansible-vault rekey` nima?
questions.explanation: Mavjud vault fayl shifrlash parolini o'zgartiradi.

questions.question: Ansible facts cache nima?
questions.explanation: Yig'ilgan fact'larni run'lar orasida (Redis, JSON fayl) saqlash — bajarilish tezlashadi.

questions.question: Pulumi native providers nima?
questions.explanation: Cloud provayder OpenAPI spetsifikatsiyalaridan avtomatik generatsiya qilingan provider'lar (azure-native, aws-native) — yangi API'larni tez qo'llaydi.

questions.question: Crossplane provider-kubernetes nima?
questions.explanation: Target klasterlarda ixtiyoriy Kubernetes resurslarini Crossplane CRD'lari orqali boshqarish.

questions.question: `terraform workspace delete` nima?
questions.explanation: Bo'sh workspace'ni o'chiradi; state'da resurs bo'lsa yiqiladi (-force xavfli).

questions.question: `terraform output -json` nima?
questions.explanation: Barcha output'larni skriptlar uchun mashina o'qiy oladigan JSON'da chiqaradi (-raw bitta qiymat uchun).

questions.question: Private registry autentifikatsiyasi qanday sozlanadi?
questions.explanation: CLI config'da (credentials "host" { token = ... } yoki TF_TOKEN_<host> env) token berish.

questions.question: Terragrunt `inputs` nima?
questions.explanation: terragrunt.hcl dan muhitga xos o'zgaruvchilarni Terraform modulga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri uzatish (TF_VAR_ sifatida).

questions.question: Ansible `requirements.yml` nima?
questions.explanation: Playbook'dan oldin avtomatik yuklanadigan third-party role va collection'larni e'lon qilish (ansible-galaxy install -r requirements.yml).

questions.question: Pulumi policy enforcement level (`mandatory` va `advisory`) farqi.
questions.explanation: advisory — ogohlantiradi; mandatory — qoida buzilsa stack yangilanishini bloklaydi.

questions.question: Crossplane `Ready: True` holati nima?
